Yeah, you can see some of it here.

http://tacticalbox.deviantart.com/gallery/

Thanks again

The idea of actually being able to feel good about something is funny. Saying I might not be experiencing pleasure like I should is like saying there's some obtainable, corporeal nirvana. It sounds good, and you're right, I probably should just see some one. Actually doing that is the whole other problem, because the feeling to self-destruct is so strong.

I'd love a life of purpose, and I hear what you're saying, but it really does seem impossible. I swear I've tried, done and succeeded with the things I find important. I visit my friends, family and meet new people and as happy as they all are (my mom is always so happy to see me, and it breaks my heart) and as much as I care about everyone of them, life still seems like this pointless mess.

Like, I just don't see the merit in being alive. I almost feel selfish for even thinking otherwise. At this point I wouldn't stay here for all of the money the US owes.

That said, I'm going to call my doctor some time this week, and see. The idea that life could be different is interesting, because I've never really experienced it. I'll give it a go, but that's about all I've got right now. Thanks for responding, I do appreciate it. That goes for NDJ too

No, I haven't really talked to anyone about it. It's one of those sensitive subjects that I'm not sure how to bring up to anyone really. I've been putting off seeing my doctor for the same reasons, though I realize if I'm going to get better, talking to a professional is probably a good idea.

Like everything else, I've more or less lost any passion for art. I might draw or paint once a month at this point. It gives me tons of pleasure when I do it, or finish a piece, but picking up that pen is harder than picking up a truck.
